releases.title: Peppercorn v0.1.0
notes: Run LTTC captures in N→S or in the new DST Capture effect, which has its own gain, volume and three-band EQ.
Assign an effect parameter to a home-screen knob or use a footswitch to switch it between two values. Assignments are saved per preset.
Auto Engage turns an effect on when you move the expression pedal, with an adjustable delay before it turns off at heel-down.
Live gain-reduction meters when editing Gate, COMP and COMP4 on the pedal.
New Auto Swell and Cloud Verb effects, plus better tuning accuracy for Pitch, Octa and Detune.
See estimated and measured load in Global Settings. CPU FULL appears if turning on an effect would overload the pedal.
